speak.title: Role-play: where should the money go?
speak.setup: Work in pairs. Your wildlife charity has £50,000 to spend. Read your card, then have the conversation. Swap roles and do it again.

a.role: the colleague who wants to protect living birds
a.text: You want to spend the money on a nature reserve for birds in danger today. Explain why. Ask your partner what they would really get for the money.

b.role: the colleague who likes the new science
b.text: You want to give the money to research that tries to bring back a lost animal. Say why it could help. Listen to your partner's worries and try to agree a plan.

phrases: I'd rather spend it on animals we can still save.
That's a fair point, but it's worth the risk.
What would we actually get for the money?
I don't think it's one or the other.
Could we split it between the two projects?
We're running out of time, so let's decide.
speak.after: Afterwards, tell the class: where did the money go, and who gave way?
